name: FadeManager
src_typeComment: Screen/scene fade, built on the Tween engine. Genuinely zero-setup: if no overlayImage is assigned, it creates its own full-screen Canvas+Image on first use (Screen Space Overlay, high sorting order so it draws over everything) — just call FadeManager.Instance.FadeOut(...) from anywhere, no scene wiring required. Assign your own overlayImage instead if you need a specific Canvas setup (e.g. a particular sort order relative to other overlay canvases).

src_serialized.name: overlayImage
src_serialized.tooltip: The full-screen Image used for fading. Auto-created at runtime if left empty.

src_members.sig: public TweenHandle FadeOut(float duration, Action onComplete = null)
src_members.name: FadeOut
src_members.comment: Fades TO fully opaque (screen covered). Also blocks raycasts through the overlay for the duration.
